title: Media Aliquoting
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect a NEST 1 Well Reservoir (195 mL), an Opentrons P1000 GEN2 single‑channel electronic pipette, and an Opentrons 96 Tip Rack (1000 µL). Prepare up to 24 custom cryotubes for aliquoting; the sample will be dispensed down columns then across rows (A1, B1, C1, D1, A2, B2, …).

steps.title: Enter pipette parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, input the number of samples to process (1‑24), the transfer volume in µL, and select the mount side for the P1000 GEN2 single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Download the protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the protocol file that incorporates the entered parameters.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as specified in the deck map: place the NEST 1 Well Reservoir, the 96‑tip rack, and the cryotubes in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the reservoir, tip rack, and pipette. Follow the app’s instructions and use the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the aliquoting protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated aliquoting of the sample into the cryotubes.
